-- Plant-Terroir Relations
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS plant_terroirs (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  plant_id INT NOT NULL,
  terroir_id INT NOT NULL,
  local_name VARCHAR(255),
  cultivation_start INT,
  annual_production VARCHAR(100),
  quality_notes TEXT,
  notes TEXT,
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE KEY unique_plant_terroir (plant_id, terroir_id)
);

-- Plant-Extraction Relations
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS plant_extractions (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  plant_id INT NOT NULL,
  extraction_method_id INT NOT NULL,
  plant_part VARCHAR(100),
  yield_percent DECIMAL(5, 3),
  yield_notes TEXT,
  product_type VARCHAR(100),
  product_quality TEXT,
  notes TEXT,
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE KEY unique_plant_extraction (plant_id, extraction_method_id)
);

-- Extended Supplier Materials
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS extended_supplier_materials (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  supplier_id INT NOT NULL,
  plant_id INT,
  variety_id INT,
  terroir_id INT,
  product_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  product_type VARCHAR(100),
  price_per_kg DECIMAL(10, 2),
  currency VARCHAR(3) DEFAULT 'EUR',
  price_date TIMESTAMP,
  availability ENUM('in_stock', 'on_order', 'seasonal', 'limited', 'discontinued', 'unknown') DEFAULT 'unknown',
  minimum_quantity VARCHAR(50),
  quality_grade VARCHAR(50),
  certifications JSON,
  notes TEXT,
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL
);
